scope: Exploratory simulation only; not confirmatory FDR/SupFDR calibration or evidence of power superiority.

selector_theory.problem: Select the maximum number of recipients with frozen baseline minimum-e-BH-credit deficits under nested source-prefix capacities.
selector_theory.feasibility: For every prefix j, cumulative selected deficit through j must not exceed total unassigned reserve from sources i<j.
selector_theory.algorithm: Process destinations in ID order; max-heap by deficit; when prefix capacity is exceeded, evict the largest deficit. Ties evict the later destination ID.
selector_theory.complexity: O(n log n) selection; O(total assignment fragments) source-first materialization.
selector_theory.claim_boundary: Maximum cardinality for fixed independent deficits, not joint e-BH threshold synergy, global power, or true-discovery optimality.

assertions: source-first assignment exactly covers selected deficits
all source IDs are strictly below destination IDs
exact_rational_validation.result: all 9000 instances passed in local exact-rational prototype; committed unittest file authored separately

statistical_pilot.null_lr_factors: 7/5 on success, 3/5 on failure; conditional mean one under p0=1/2
statistical_pilot.adjuster: floor to 1e-6 grid of sqrt(running maximum LR)-1
statistical_pilot.supfdr_point_estimates: all zero in this 20-stream pilot; no calibration inference
statistical_pilot.execution_note: The statistical table came from a separate local exact-Fraction simulator aligned with the committed policy model. The committed benchmark itself has not been run from a connected checkout.

interpretation: The batch heap selector matched brute-force cardinality optimum for the frozen-deficit allocation problem.
The batch policy did not improve terminal power over one-target minimum-credit in these cells.
Fixed-next remained better in the immediate-bridge design; the result is scenario-specific.
The late-bridge case did not show a two-phase advantage in this pilot.
The statistical sample size is far too small for meaningful error-rate or power claims.
claim_ceiling: A deterministic prefix-selection result plus a small exploratory simulation. No SOTA, confirmatory validity, or statistical superiority claim.
